home.heroSubtitle: Smile connects older adults in our community who need a hand with translation, technology, errands, and appointments to younger volunteers nearby who are ready to help.
home.step1Body: Post a short request: translating a letter, setting up a phone, a ride to the doctor, groceries, or anything else.
home.step2Body: Helpers browse open requests and claim the ones they can do. You'll know right away who is coming.
home.step3Body: Message each other to arrange details, then mark the request as completed when you're done.
home.trustBody: Every account is reviewed by an admin before it can post or help, so this stays a trusted circle of neighbors.

categories.translationDesc: Help understanding letters, forms, or conversations from Vietnamese to English or back.
categories.techSetupDesc: Setting up a phone, computer, video calls, or apps.
categories.transportationDesc: Rides to appointments, errands, or visits.
categories.groceriesDesc: Picking up groceries, medications, or running small errands.
categories.companionshipDesc: A friendly visit or phone call to check in.
categories.paperworkDesc: Help filling out bank, insurance, or government forms.
